definitions.explanation: Having a large number of children, said of a family, a couple, or a parent.

examples.japanese: うち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子沢山|こだくさん}だ。
examples.english: We have a lot of kids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父母|そふぼ}→祖父母：03110_sofubo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{子沢山|こだくさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In my grandparents' day, many families had lots of children.

examples.japanese: {子沢山|こだくさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦にぎやか→にぎやか：00873_nigiyaka⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{食費|しょくひ}→食費：16477_shokuhi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かなり→かなり：01149_kanari⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: A family with many children is lively every day, but the food bill is considerable too.

notes:
⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (child) + {沢山|たくさん} (many), with ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧ voiced to だくさん. Often written ⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧だくさん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子沢山|こだくさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧: a family with many children
- {子沢山|こだくさん}な⟦{夫婦|ふうふ}→夫婦：03592_fuufu⟧: a couple with many children
- {律儀者|りちぎもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子沢山|こだくさん}: an honest, steady man has many children (proverb)

USAGE:
A warm, everyday word, not a statistical one; reports on birth rates speak of {多子|たし}⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧ (households with many children).
